## Purpose
Shows a diagnostics run: a summary line, then one row per check (pass, warn, fail, skip), plus the host facts.

## Responsibilities
- `CheckReportView({report})` and `HostFacts({system})` (OS, CPU, memory, disk, Docker and so on).

## Key elements
`CheckReportView`, `HostFacts`.

React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Interactions
- Shows `checks.run_checks` results. Used by the server pages and the form test.
